title: Improving Advance Care Planning by Care Partners of Persons Living With Dementia Using a Narrative Video Game
official: Improving Advance Care Planning by Care Partners of Persons Living With Dementia Using a Narrative Video Game
summary: The primary objective of this study is to evaluate the feasibility of using a narrative video game intervention to improve advance care planning (ACP) among care partners of people living with Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementia. Feasibility will be assessed by evaluating acceptability as well as the fidelity of intervention delivery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be 18 years or older
* Identify as the primary support person (care partner) for health-related decisions for a person with dementia

Exclusion Criteria:

* the person with dementia has died
* the care partner does not have an email address
* the care partner is unwilling to be recorded
